title: Asymptotic normalized total influence
statement: For each fixed integer $k\ge 0$, as the integer $r$ tends to infinity, the total influence of the degree-$k$ Gotsman–Linial extremizer on the $(k+r)$-dimensional Boolean cube, divided by $\sqrt{k+r}$, tends to $k\sqrt{2/\pi}$.
